what: Conditional predictions for any run that is in the all-miss request-level-FCFS trap (follow-up hit < 0.2) over its evaluation window: the turn mix and mean prompt of the turns served, the cycle growth (trend of the gap between a session's consecutive turns), the session completion rate and the backlog slope. Inputs: the frozen cell specs only; no run result is read.

llama31_fit.lambda_ref_source: Llama-3.1-8B E0a lambda_miss_turns_based (speed fitted to its E0a token rate)

h200_600k.lambda_ref_source: H200 300k E0a lambda_miss_turns_based (the 600k E2 runs use it)

scoring.applies_to: every run of a new experiment whose follow-up hit fraction over its evaluation window is below 0.2 and whose window starts at least 3000 s after the trigger began (burst, tool slowdown, long-prompt batch, a spontaneous from-empty collapse, a running-request cap, ...), on a cell listed here, at the run's nominal multiple of the cell's lambda_ref (nearest grid row, or linear interpolation in mult)
scoring.S1_composition: mean prompt of the turns completed in the window within +-8% of P_served_mean (per run); the pooled mean within +-5%
scoring.S2_cycle_growth: OLS slope of the 300 s medians of the gap (turn completion minus the same session's previous turn completion) against time, pooled over the runs of a (cell, multiple): within [0.6, 1.4] x gamma
scoring.S3_youth_premium: session completion rate in the window above lambda_ref in every trapped run whose realized arrival rate over the window is at least 1.1 lambda_ref; pooled mean within +-15% of D_over_lam_ref x lambda_ref
scoring.S4_backlog: pooled mean OLS slope of the 10 s bin means of sessions in the system within +-35% of alpha (asymptotic) or of fluid_slope (E2 protocol); individual runs scatter with sd about stoch_slope_sd
scoring.S5_per_seed: for a run whose arrival plan is the client's constant-rate plan (seed known), the per-run slope is predicted by slope_plugin = lam_window_plan - D (the realized base-arrival rate of the plan over the window minus Theorem 1's trapped completion rate); scored by the sign of slope - 0.5 (lam - lam_ref) (the registered trap-slope criterion) and by |slope - slope_plugin| <= 0.01 /s
scoring.refutation: Theorem 1's application to the engine is refuted for a (cell, multiple) if S1 fails for the pooled mean or S2 fails, in a group of at least two trapped runs
scoring.note: tolerances were set after seeing the committed runs (results/theory/icml/trap_check.md), so they are calibrated on existing data; the predictions they score are for runs that did not exist when this file was pushed
